_rule: as English: strip surrounding punctuation (ASCII + CJK full-width); fold case ONLY where the lowercase form also appears, which touches the ASCII subset only. Route by script: a unit containing any CJK character goes to the ZH instrument, the rest to the EN one -- 13.6% of this 'Chinese' population is English tokens the tokenizer emits at Chinese prompts, and telling the coder they are Chinese would be wrong. Nothing is excluded for being non-Chinese: those tokens genuinely move.
